findings.text: The five-sample subdivision brackets a root only on a sub-interval whose ends straddle the level, so two roots inside one sub-interval are still lost, one scale finer than the corner-sign blind spot the repair replaced: measured on the same fitted spline the tracer uses, at state 9's committed level -0.081614263, saddle cell (j=5,i=9) carries four edge crossings (bottom 1, left 2 at 19.36 mm separation, right 1) while all four left-edge subdivision deltas are positive (+2.174e-03 +2.661e-04 +1.648e-05 +1.256e-03 +3.815e-03, straddle [0,0,0,0]), so cell_crossing_count reads 2, the gate at line 1666 is false and the sector tie cannot fire; states 10, 11 and 12 fail identically with left-edge separations 10.60, 1.29 and 8.15 mm, and state 0's control cell reaches its count of 4 only because its 29.68 mm right-edge pair happens to straddle a sub-interval boundary, so detection turns on sub-interval alignment rather than on any physical threshold; bracket the sign change inside each sub-interval (or its interior extremum) instead of the endpoint straddle alone.

The recorded residual mechanism -- 'the level set through the admitted saddle crosses only two of the saddle cell's four edges' -- is falsified by the fixture: the level crosses all four edges of cell (5,9) on state 9, twice on the left edge 19.36 mm apart, and the count of 2 belongs to the detector, not the geometry; the same sentence is carried into the landing section and the commit body, so the record's mechanism for the four residual states should be corrected before further work is queued off it.

The redrawn panel's blue reference set is the fixture's stored reference_separatrix drawn verbatim as one dashed polyline, and that array is a crossing list in scan order (rows 0-5 are pairs at constant z: 0.105937/0.260605 at z=0, 0.105769/0.26336 at z=-0.125, 0.105222/0.271288 at z=-0.25), so the panel shows a 128-vertex fan of rays from near the axis to the wall that no level set of a smooth flux map can resemble -- the spray the lead flagged on 2026-09-18; it is not a data-orientation defect (the array maps isotropically at 73.8 px/m, spanning 1.298 m by 3.924 m in both the array and the drawing, and the reference raster reproduces its own stored axis 0.90336131/0.02246996, saddle 0.58497079/1.2305167 and caption flux -0.122930), and the note at line 1507 'unassembled at its own saddle level, drawn dashed from its separatrix' does not tell the reader the dashed blue is a point list rather than a contour; draw the reference's own level set, or markers, or drop the set.

The queued fix -- 'count the saddle's own cell ambiguous when the level set crosses two of its edges' -- targets the ambiguity gate rather than the detector and would not close the lobe: the only two crossings the ring holds on state 9 are the bottom and right ones, which the count==2 path already joins, so forcing the tie fires on a cell whose two missing left-edge crossings are still absent and the cycle still cannot close; the repair belongs in the bracket, not in the gate.

The panel's reference is a different equilibrium configuration from the solved set -- its admitted saddle sits at z=+1.2305, above its own axis at z=+0.0225, while all twenty solved states carry their saddle below their axis (saddle z in [-1.3339,-1.2398], axis z in [-0.1769,-0.0831]) -- so a reader comparing panels compares an upper-X-point reference against lower-X-point solves; state the reference case in the caption, or use a same-orientation reference.

justifications.durability: Six commits each carry a subject and a body with no attribution trailer and no plan or ticket label, the tip 18fd78a7 is an ancestor of my base ff1e08bb so the work is merged and reachable, the two new persisted-state parametrisations are committed and collected in the first-hand re-run, and the fixture and redrawn figure are committed; the residual risk is that the fixture is stale against its own driver by the node's recorded evidence input, so the census reproduces against a raster a re-run would regenerate differently.
justifications.evidence: Every recorded number reproduces first-hand at its stated precision (census 4 of 20 with states 9-12; gate 30 passed in 108.66 s at the reviewed tip against 112.62 s recorded; the state 0 and state 13 term constants exact; the void earlier gate run and the stale-fixture provenance departure named rather than hidden), but the residual mechanism was read off the tracer's own counter rather than measured on the field, and a dense scan of the same fitted field contradicts it in all four states.
justifications.fit: The work follows house convention -- focused gate on all_debug through the shared interpreter, tests in the mirror file, mechanism-worded comments, module boundaries kept, the axis threaded through forward.py rather than reached around -- and the redraw obeys the plotting rules with the wall and both null sets drawn; it loses points for a delivered panel that still shows the reference as a fan of dashed rays, exactly the defect the lead flagged on 2026-09-18, and for a reference case whose captions do not identify it as a different equilibrium orientation.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The repair is real and first-hand reproducible -- the census on the persisted fixture reproduces exactly (4 of 20 fail, states 9-12, levels identical to 9 digits; state 0 closed 67 open 2 and state 13 closed 66 open 0; the displaced-level control at 1e-3 leaves closed_candidate_count 0) and no state regressed -- but the defect class the repair exists to remove survives one scale finer, the four residual states are instances of it, and the mechanism recorded for them is falsified by the fixture, so the goal holds for 16 of 20 states on a detector whose adequacy turns on sub-interval alignment.
justifications.scope_discipline: All nine changed paths lie inside the declared write paths, the probe scratch was moved out of the worktree to the reports area uncommitted, the plan edited is the plan being landed against, and tests, evidence and figure sit in their own trees; the one soft spot is diagnose_branch_terms.py and branch-terms.json committed into the published figures directory, which is inside the declared paths and cited by the anchor but is analysis rather than a figure.
